QUOTE: "Shared by: every `this.batchRecords(...)` call in the handlers (for example `post.ts`, `thread.ts`, `group.ts`, `properties.ts`, `user.ts`, and the three product mixins)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says batchRecords is inherited from BaseDataOperator via ServerDataOperatorBase. It never says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase. It also says some writes bypass batchRecords, which doesn't match "every handler's writes go through" it.
